news.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
news.summary: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.

news.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
news.summary: Users paid nearly $6 million in a day to create and trade tokens through Pons, more than they paid to use Pump or Hyperliquid, and even more than they paid to use Robinhood Chain itself.

news.title: Crypto for Advisors: Why crypto earnings reports can be misleading
Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
news.summary: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

news.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
news.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

news.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
news.summary: Every major token gained on Friday as traders cut bets on a September Federal Reserve rate increase to a coin flip, though most of the majors are barely changed on the week.

news.title: One full bitcoin now buys a little more than 18 ounces of gold, the most since January
news.summary: Bitcoin is pulling ahead of gold even as both hard assets rally together, driven by fears that governments will inflate away their debt rather than by bond yields.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
